readOnly.FORMAT_TOO_OLD: Read-only: this map was written by FreeMind or an older Freeplane. Open it with Freeplane 1.12 or later and save it to edit it here.
readOnly.FORMAT_TOO_NEW: Read-only: this map was written by a Freeplane version newer than mapling supports. Check for a mapling update.
readOnly.DUPLICATE_IDS: Read-only: some nodes of this map share the same identifier, so editing could change the wrong node. Open and save it with Freeplane to repair it.
hidden.notice: This map contains items that are not shown here: {kinds}. They are kept.
confirm.discard: The open map has unsaved changes. Discard them?
draft.restore: Unsaved changes to {name} from {date} were kept. Restore them?
draft.failed: Unsaved changes cannot be kept as a draft in this browser: they are not protected.
error.PARSE_ERROR: This file cannot be read: it is not valid XML.
error.NOT_A_MAP: This file is not a mind map.
error.UNSUPPORTED_ENCODING: This file uses a text encoding that mapling does not support (UTF-8 only).
error.OUTDATED_COMMAND: The map changed in the meantime: please try again.
download.confirm: A copy was downloaded. Once you have checked it is saved where you want, confirm it: until then the map stays modified and its draft is kept.
draft.restoreOther: Unsaved changes to a file named {name}, from {date}, were kept. They were made on another file with this name, or on an earlier version of this one. Restore them anyway? (Then download the copy under another name.) If you decline, they are kept.
hint.locked: Text not editable here (rich or multi-line text): edit it in Freeplane. The node can still be moved or deleted.
hint.hidden: This node holds items that are not shown here, and kept: {items}.
